title: ANNEAL：通过受控符号补丁学习自适应LLM智能体
summary: ANNEAL是一种神经符号智能体，通过故障驱动知识获取（FDKA）机制，将重复故障转化为过程知识图谱的受控符号编辑，无需修改模型权重。在四个领域27次多种子运行中，ANNEAL将重复故障率从72-100%降至0%，消融实验显示移除FDKA后成功率下降26.7个百分点。
summary_en: ANNEAL is a neuro-symbolic agent that converts recurring failures into governed symbolic edits of a process knowledge graph via Failure-Driven Knowledge Acquisition (FDKA), without modifying model weights. Across four domains and 27 multi-seed runs, it reduces recurring failure rates from 72-100% to 0%, with ablation showing a 26.7 percentage point drop in success rate when FDKA is removed.
